changes: Adds the approved five finite custody marker variants with recordedAtKind to response receipt payloads only.
Passes immutable request-local decoded capture through the existing client; arbitrary exceptions never become a measured send.
Binds custody to original dispatch and page intent receipts, fixed owner and data generation, exact indexed refs and raw SHA; does not require the current head to remain the original intent head.
Adds source.restoreUsage returning original request/intent/response receipt metadata and page usage without project, manifest, discovery or fetch.
Retains legacy unmarked body validation; marked bodies require returned and observation before the original lease/deadline; captured/failure cannot become a page.
Preserves original call errors and a simultaneous custody persistence failure as an AggregateError.
dependencies: core staging ports.ts and ToolContracts restoreReadUsage
core Broker and ReadCollections authorizeResponseCustody forwarding
limitations: This adapter returns page measurements only; whole-attempt accounting and protected ContextRecovery refs belong to unit B.
No runtime or TypeScript build was executed; root must integrate the staged port changes and run the approved checks.
The existing checkpoint reader is reused for original intent proof; no new ledger, schema version or online fallback is introduced.
